scope: opt-in visual art direction; never infer from other users or force into unrelated requests

influencedBy.concept: silhouette iteration, scene readability, motion draft before pixel polish
motion technique depends on subject, after-paint detail cleanup

pillars.description: physical wear and use reflected in intentional silhouette, not random scratches
glass, brass, cloth, stone, flame require distinct highlight and shadow geometry
one dominant highlight focal area and supported secondary light
frozen base plus independently timed semantic motion layers

moss.meaning: deserted stone, plants and old craft

gates.name: scene-check
gates.deliverable: dark, light and target environment readability

gates.name: key-poses
gates.deliverable: motion intention and key pose frames without polish

gates.name: polish
gates.deliverable: cluster cleanup, motion-aware lighting, seamless loop

gates.name: jury
gates.deliverable: 1x visible human review and comparison; structural tests do not qualify

stageGuidance.director: Invent a fresh object backstory, propose three materially different silhouettes, pick a coherent mood. Avoid recognizable third-party shapes.
stageGuidance.silhouette: Concentrate on identity, physical function, negative space, asymmetry with cause. No microtexture yet.
stageGuidance.fill: Shade in 3 purposeful value families first; choose glass/metal/cloth/stone-specific spatial behavior.
stageGuidance.highlights: Keep brightest cluster rare and local to material/light logic; do not spread isolated highlights.
stageGuidance.effects: Animate semantic parts around stable anchors. No generic whole-sprite bob or random sparkle. Test last-to-first transition.
stageGuidance.repair: Edit only the selected layer, affected frames, and bounding box; keep approved silhouettes and color logic.
